method: Official public product/docs only; no authenticated live workflows; U means unknown, not absent. Adoption is Zyara's planned treatment even when competitor capability unknown.

features.name: Discovery
features.zyara: Public verified graph connects service, place and actual access.

features.name: Doctor search
features.zyara: Resolve role and branch, not only clinician name.

features.name: Symptom search
features.zyara: Clinician-reviewed navigation with abstention, not diagnosis.

features.name: Specialty search
features.zyara: Curated multilingual specialty and subspecialty terms.

features.name: Facility search
features.zyara: Distinguish group, branch and department.

features.name: Location search
features.zyara: District, address and entrance confidence.

features.name: Map
features.zyara: Accessible synchronized list, entrances and evidence.

features.name: Insurance search
features.zyara: Exact product/network/site/service/date; benefits unknown.

features.name: Availability
features.zyara: Freshness, authority and eligibility visible.

features.name: Instant booking
features.zyara: Only when the authoritative system confirms.

features.name: Appointment request
features.zyara: Clear deadline, owner and unresolved queue.

features.name: Patient confirmation
features.zyara: Booking confirmation separate from attendance response.

features.name: Cancellation
features.zyara: Low-friction scoped action and recovery after cutoff.

features.name: Rescheduling
features.zyara: Preserve original until replacement secured.

features.name: Waitlist
features.zyara: Preferences, real holds, expiry and fairness.

features.name: Cancellation refill
features.zyara: Track actual replacement and safe original cancellation.

features.name: Recall
features.zyara: Authorized clinical source and defined stop conditions.

features.name: Follow-up
features.zyara: Clinician-authored windows, no AI schedule invention.

features.name: Intake
features.zyara: Collect minimal relevant data at the right step.

features.name: Forms
features.zyara: Versioned and accessible with restricted visibility.

features.name: Consent
features.zyara: Purpose-specific, revocable and auditable.

features.name: Messaging
features.zyara: Pilot transactional communication; clinical chat later.

features.name: Check-in
features.zyara: Separate arrival, identity check and clinical completion.

features.name: Telehealth
features.zyara: Book approved provider sessions first; no new clinical platform.

features.name: Provider portal
features.zyara: Role-limited operations, not entire EHR.

features.name: Provider calendar
features.zyara: Keyboard/list parity and real command validation.

features.name: Multi-provider
features.zyara: Schedules attach to roles and shared human resources.

features.name: Multi-location
features.zyara: Branch scope and cross-location time conflicts.

features.name: Multi-resource
features.zyara: Atomic unit recipes and service constraints.

features.name: Recurring care
features.zyara: Bounded series after single-visit safety.

features.name: Linked appointments
features.zyara: Explicit prerequisites and partial confirmation.

features.name: Referrals
features.zyara: Access task with issuer, window and closure evidence.

features.name: Clinical order scheduling
features.zyara: Order validation and clinical review before enablement.

features.name: Reviews
features.zyara: Separate practitioner/facility experience dimensions.

features.name: Review verification
features.zyara: Attendance evidence plus independent patient appeal.

features.name: Provider replies
features.zyara: Moderated, no confirmation of private medical facts.

features.name: Reputation tools
features.zyara: Invite all eligible visits; reject sentiment gating.

features.name: Reminders
features.zyara: Consent, quiet hours and current appointment version.

features.name: Email
features.zyara: Generic previews and secure access.

features.name: SMS
features.zyara: Approved sender, locale and opt-out/purpose controls.

features.name: WhatsApp
features.zyara: Approved vendor/template/consent before release.

features.name: Voice/phone
features.zyara: Assisted access remains available; automated calling gated.

features.name: AI
features.zyara: Typed facts, exact confirmation, no autonomous treatment.

features.name: Call-center automation
features.zyara: Prove safe structured navigation first.

features.name: Provider analytics
features.zyara: Measured operations value with missingness/coverage.

features.name: Conversion analytics
features.zyara: Separate intent, request and authoritative booking.

features.name: No-show analytics
features.zyara: Eligible denominator and corrected attendance evidence.

features.name: Capacity analytics
features.zyara: Service/resource minutes and useful refill outcomes.

features.name: Integration capabilities
features.zyara: Versioned capabilities and explicit authority.

features.name: EHR/HIS/PMS integrations
features.zyara: Certified per service/customer, not a logo count.

features.name: API
features.zyara: Scoped contracts, idempotency and quotas.

features.name: FHIR
features.zyara: R4 boundary first with tested version/profile mapping.

features.name: HL7 v2
features.zyara: SIU and middleware adapters with negotiated profile.

features.name: Patient records
features.zyara: Consented provenance timeline; no EHR replacement.

features.name: Family/dependents
features.zyara: Separate identity, legal authority and sensitive scopes.

features.name: Accessibility
features.zyara: WCAG 2.2 AA target and human usability testing.

features.name: Localization
features.zyara: Arabic RTL plus four first-class locales and medical terminology.

features.name: Mobile apps
features.zyara: Responsive accessible web/PWA first; native justified by evidence.

features.name: Monetization
features.zyara: Provider operations SaaS; free patient access.

features.name: Provider pricing model
features.zyara: Subscription/integration economics; no paid organic rank.

features.name: Patient pricing model
features.zyara: Reject booking fees; provider care payment remains separate.

competitors.name: Doctolib
competitors.scope: France patient/provider help; not every national edition
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Waitlist alerts and calendar changes are established workflows. Do not infer identical allocation rules across countries or from old PDFs.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Zocdoc
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Booked/attended verification has important source distinctions; partner reviews are not all equivalent. AI navigation alone is not unique.
competitors.pricing: Patients book free; marketplace charges per new-patient booking, variable by specialty/geography; exact amount unverified. Reject this commission model.

competitors.name: Vezeeta Saudi
competitors.finding: Local specialty/city/area/insurer discovery is already present. Verification mechanics, authoritative write behavior and full provider economics were not established by public evidence.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Okadoc
competitors.scope: Saudi professional page; UAE claims not Saudi approval
competitors.finding: Markets HIS-connected booking and prebooking uploads. Contracted adapter capabilities and Saudi data handling still require validation.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Docplanner
competitors.finding: Parent platform provides access/reputation/operations; count separately as a researched product entry, not an independent rival to its own brands.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Doctoralia
competitors.finding: Spanish product combines practice operations and reputation. Do not extrapolate pricing or verification policy to all Docplanner countries.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Practo / Ray
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Clinic calendar and patient communication are coupled to a broader PMS. Borrow operations, defer billing/charting.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: OneDoc
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Language, gender and insurer filters help intent matching; video links do not establish cross-border telehealth authorization.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Healthgrades
competitors.finding: Search spans condition/procedure and facility. Review attendance verification and scheduling ownership remain unknown.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Jane
competitors.finding: Resource/room calendars and waitlist are a strong usability baseline. Privacy mode and accessible alternatives should be designed explicitly.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: SimplePractice
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Documented online requests require practice approval/decline. Do not label them instant bookings.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Tebra
competitors.finding: Markets connected availability and intake/reputation workflows. Vendor outcome percentages were not independently evaluated.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: NexHealth
competitors.finding: Waitlist matching/preferences and EHR synchronization are commodity expectations. Its vendor API capabilities vary by system and version.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: ModMed
competitors.scope: US specialty suite; advertised future language separated
competitors.finding: Specialty workflow depth matters. Broad AI and suite marketing does not prove individual scheduling features are generally available.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: DrChrono
competitors.finding: EHR-connected online access and OnPatient continuity compete with the longer-term timeline; avoid rebuilding the full EHR.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Open Dental
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: ASAP can offer earlier appointments. Recall flow has specific restrictions, including no patient change after booking in the documented Recall route.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Dentrix Ascend
competitors.finding: Operatories and dental service workflows justify specialty validation; suite marketing is not a tested resource-atomicity contract.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: WebPT
competitors.finding: Rehabilitation outcomes/charting are adjacent. Zyara should model approved treatment series without copying clinical documentation scope.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Kyruus Health
competitors.scope: US health-system/payer products; current site says joins RevSpring
competitors.finding: Provider-data consolidation and embedded search/scheduling already exist. Zyara's graph must win on Saudi evidence and operational correction.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Luma Health
competitors.finding: Closed-loop access work is the benchmark. Public waitlist pages did not establish exact priority/fairness algorithms.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: athenahealth / athenaPatient
competitors.scope: US practice-enabled app and announced agentic tools
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Self-scheduling and app features depend on practice enablement. Agentic communication announcement for H2 2026 is not proof of deployment.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Epic / MyChart
competitors.finding: Guest scheduling and rich family/record continuity are strong incumbents. Do not assume every institution enables every feature.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Oracle Health / Millennium
competitors.scope: Millennium API and Patient Portal documentation
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Resource-list types and customer-specific IDs constrain Slot APIs; documented order-role limitations invalidate a universal FHIR scheduling assumption.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Phreesia
competitors.finding: Administrative access/intake breadth is useful; full revenue-cycle functions would dilute Zyara's first wedge.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: TuoTempo
competitors.finding: WhatsApp, voice and self-check-in are already marketed together. Integration reliability and patient control must distinguish Zyara.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: LeanTaaS
competitors.finding: A stronger adjacent resource-optimization reference; defer theatre/bed optimization until mature clinical partnerships.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: HotDoc
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Clinical recall work has responsible practice ownership. Do not treat clinical reminders as an unreviewed marketing campaign.
competitors.pricing: Official general-practice page describes monthly subscription per active practitioner; exact amount not verified.

competitors.name: Healthengine
competitors.finding: Notification coverage may include appointments from other sources; enforce purpose/minimization rather than importing all PMS data.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Sehhaty (MOH)
competitors.scope: Saudi national app; distinct from legacy Mawid
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Free public-sector scheduling and family care are major existing patient alternatives. Zyara must complement national services rather than assume a greenfield.
competitors.pricing: MOH appointment service documented free; unrelated care costs not inferred.

competitors.name: Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Group
competitors.scope: Saudi official application page; partial dynamic content
competitors.finding: Hospital app offers integrated patient journey. Public page is partly dynamic; detailed reschedule/verification mechanics not established.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Saudi German Health
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Web/app/call booking and facility-specific insurance routes exist. Confirm actual mode on the selected branch rather than infer global instant semantics.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Dallah Health
competitors.finding: Family files, appointments, labs and imaging continuity are established hospital-app expectations; external directory data alone is weaker.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Almoosa Health
competitors.scope: Saudi booking form and patient portal
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Public form says staff contact the patient to confirm; classify as request, not instant. Portal supports Arabic/English and remote/in-person choices.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: KFSHRC / Altakhassusi
competitors.finding: Current page describes appointment management and record access, but not unrestricted open instant booking. Older Sehaty naming is historical and distinct from MOH Sehhaty.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Cura
competitors.finding: Arabic consultation, home/lab/radiology-related services broaden access competition. Provider licensing claims require independent verification before Zyara mirrors them.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Altibbi
competitors.finding: Human phone/text consultation and health information compete for the first care-seeking interaction. Distinguish consultation fees from booking fees.
competitors.pricing: Subscription/consultation flow observed; exact price and country terms not verified.

competitors.name: Mawidy
competitors.scope: Saudi/MENA public product site; not MOH Mawid or mawidi.com
competitors.finding: Markets clinic/hospital booking, home care and AI. Broad marketing does not establish actual integration reliability.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Dubai Health app
competitors.scope: UAE official government publisher app listing
competitors.finding: Government mobile access combines appointments and records; app listing is published feature evidence, not a tested session.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Sahatna
competitors.scope: Abu Dhabi, UAE government telemedicine overview
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Government source describes remote/in-person appointments and records; UAE mechanisms do not imply Saudi integration permission.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: HeliumDoc / Meddy
competitors.finding: Official 2021 acquisition confirms historic Qatar/UAE relevance. Current heliumdoc.com returned 403; current features/prices are unknown. Not counted as a current detailed capability validation.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Cal.com
competitors.scope: Horizontal scheduling official workflow page and source repository
competitors.finding: Official workflow page markets routing/round-robin, buffers, caps, email/SMS/WhatsApp, API/webhooks and reschedule links. These are useful horizontal patterns; sales qualification and weighted revenue routing are not healthcare eligibility. The /features URL returned an unrelated booking profile and was excluded.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.

competitors.name: Google Calendar appointment schedules
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Buffers, booking windows and exceptions are useful; documentation says resource calendars cannot receive appointment schedules and cohost availability is not checked by default.
competitors.pricing: Basic/paid feature availability depends on Google account/eligible subscription; exact amount not verified.

competitors.name: Microsoft Bookings / Graph
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Shared Bookings data lives in Exchange mailboxes. Licensing and data handling need procurement review; staff calendars do not establish clinical multi-resource eligibility.
competitors.pricing: Included in listed eligible Microsoft subscriptions; list/edition must be rechecked at purchase, no amount asserted.

competitors.name: Easy!Appointments
competitors.confidence: high for described contract; untested live
competitors.finding: Useful small scheduler reference with group sessions and calendar sync; documented recurring-sync limits show why generic calendar interoperability is insufficient.
competitors.pricing: Public amount not verified; procurement/edition confirmation required.
